posts.description: We believe logos should visually represent its parent company: its values, philopsophy, and what sets it apart. Did you notice anything different about our logo? It’s unique! posts.title: variart Is Back
posts.description: variart has been quiet for a long time. Years, really. The site kept running and every piece kept drawing itself for anyone who stopped by, but I stopped adding to it. I’m picking it back up. That’s all 68 pieces, one variant each. You can finally browse them by what they actually look like: grids , circles , optical , organic , and a dozen more. posts.title: Bringing Generative Art Into Your Living Room
posts.description: Generative art (that is, using computer code to generate art) is not new. In fact pioneering algorists like Ben F. Laposky and Roman Verostko have been using code to generate printed pieces since the 1950s and 60s.
